name: v1.4.0
body:
## Changelog
### New Features
* d77ba90c17efcb198678d35e69c06475d5224016: feat(resolvers): bind queries to a source address with -b/--source (#250) (@ChrisJr404)
* a0dd1da4a0ba29b66ea5234a4fad39a36c63ddb9: feat(trace): add iterative DNS delegation tracing (@mr-karan)
### Bug fixes
* 08ee9ecf616bfff787a4a6c6e308fb5125a839bf: fix(ci): migrate to globalping-go v0.2.0 and bump Go to 1.26.6 (@mr-karan)
* 4a540ab90a518a8e8c9a4eb945a55fcdb30930d7: fix(cli): add missing flags to shell completions (#257) (@mr-karan)
* 3111835568f15d66e3459d546339dc6cbec7a7d3: fix(darwin): use and report domain-specific scutil resolvers (#253) (@richardmilles)
* 80946ad93f1b6a7586e59660bc3771079b20a306: fix(deps): adapt to globalping-go v0.3.0 Probe.State pointer (#258) (@mr-karan)
* ece94db96d358eac7080ed3493571656c09ff3d3: fix(output): write EDNS footer through color.Output (#256) (@mr-karan)
* 895174da1d55453905725be05a916e4675881428: fix(resolvers): harden --source binding across transports (@mr-karan)
* e9166eeb034b698ce26eb2be2f94147676473bad: fix(resolvers): size UDP receive buffer for non-EDNS queries (#251) (@mr-karan)
* 7647a7e090ef0a1486e0fc37c9729ee98166dd00: fix(trace): harden invalid invocation handling (@mr-karan)
